checks: Verified source f29d64ab4f68c3cc at its recorded byte digest. Section 4, equations (11)–(12), gives the Jensen comparison and the path. The frozen hypotheses retain the exact row identities and contact value used there without importing the source's chart or grouping construction.

For a positive row, its normalized measure is a probability and W_Q/L has mean one. The function x to x^(−p) is convex and decreasing for p>0. The pointwise upper bound U≤b_Q W_Q and Jensen give the two inequalities with lower bound b_Q^(−p)s_Q. Nonnegativity makes a zero row the zero measure. Summing the rows gives total target mass one and the stated source sum.

The finite minimum U of positive affine functions is concave and uniformly positive on the compact hull. Direct differentiation of (x^(−p)+t y^(−p))^(−1/p) gives the stated nonnegative partials and Hessian. The matrix factor is the outer product of (y,−x), so the Hessian is negative semidefinite, including t=0 when the map is x. The monotone concave composition applies when L is concave.

The log path is −log(1+t(L/U)^p)/p. Its quotient by t is uniformly bounded for t>0 by (L/U)^p/p, and the right derivative has the negative sign shown. Both target and weighted source measures are finite. Nonnegativity of source minus target with zero initial value yields the comparison with the inequality in the stated direction. Only positive-weight marks require the contact identity.
